info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Trading Models Retrieval API
info.description: The Trading Models Retrieval API provides access to a comprehensive set of trading models utilized in wholesale banking. This endpoint allows users to fetch specific trading model details based on a given parameter. Typically consumed by system integrators and financial analysts, it facilitates data extraction for analysis or integration into trading platforms. This API supports enhanced decision-making in trading operations by offering the necessary insights into model characteristics, performance, and applicability.

get.description: This endpoint retrieves detailed information about the trading model identified by RES-100045. Utilize this to access model specifications, settings, and parameters relevant to wholesale trading.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve details for the trading model identified by RES-100045. It may include filters or parameters that specify the data to be returned.

GetWholesaleTradingModelRes100045Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation in the wholesale trading context.

tradingBookId.description: Unique identifier for the trading book.

side.description: The side of the trade, e.g., 'buy' or 'sell'.

quantity.description: The quantity of the instrument being traded.

limitPrice.description: The limit price at which the trade is set.

recordStatus.description: The current status of the record.

version.description: Version number of the trading record.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the record was last updated.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the trading operation.

GetWholesaleTradingModelRes100045Respons.description: Response schema for the operations related to the trading models.

value.description: The value of the limit price.

currency.description: The currency in which the limit price is denominated.

LimitPrice.description: Limit price details including value and currency.

correlationId.description: Identifier used to correlate related requests and responses.

processingRegion.description: The region where the processing took place.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the request endpoint. This ID helps in tracking the request to the specific endpoint in the trading operations.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the runtime application that handled the request. This header is useful for identifying the application context in which the operation was processed.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses Bearer authentication with JSON Web Tokens (JWT) to authorize access to the API. Clients must include a valid JWT in the Authorization header of their requests.
